reviews.text: My dog ​​came back scared from a walk, I wouldn't hire their service again.
The so-called "obedience" manifested through violence is actually fear. Pay attention if your dog is afraid to go to daycare.

We were moving and I needed to leave Francisco, my 10-month-old cocker spaniel, at a dog hotel for 5 days. He'd never been away from us before and has a little difficulty socializing with other dogs. My wife and I are extremely worried about him, and Dog Walker Obedience *always* met our needs! They sent us photos and videos whenever we asked, kept us informed of any incidents, gave Francisco a bath and grooming, and removed all his knots. The surprise came when he arrived home – HE WAS A SWEETHEART! He's always been a very energetic little dog, even when walking, and very territorial. On the very first night after the hotel, he slept with me and my wife (something he had never done before!) and was a SWEETHEART playing fetch with me. Suddenly, he learned to switch off when it was time to rest! I highly recommend them!

It was the first time I left Leo at a dog hotel.

Very good, he was well treated, came back super calm and happy.

From now on, only here...
I highly recommend it.

This is the second time I've left Dolores at the hotel and she was great! I traveled with peace of mind because the staff is wonderful and caring, and they even send photos and videos of the pets daily! I especially want to highlight three people that Dolores adores: Beatriz, Júlio, and Ciamara. You can trust your furry children to these competent professionals!

They let my dog ​​bite during the adaptation phase, and lied saying it was just a game!
And when a video of the dog is requested, they send it muted, hiding the background sounds.
I recommend it, a wonderful space for your pet!

Excellent; I recommend them without hesitation; the staff is very attentive and caring with our furry children; Benjamin and Joaquim love going to daycare; and they sent a special hug to Aunt Bia, whom they love very much ❤️
Excellent service, pet-friendly company!
Besides the space being really cool, the staff is very caring and treats the little ones with great affection! Having DogWalker's own "school bus" service makes things much easier!
My puppy attends daycare and at the end of the year used their boarding service! The professionals are polite and super attentive to the dogs 😍 I highly recommend them. …
Best daycare/hotel ever! My dog ​​loves it! The whole team is very attentive and caring. I highly recommend it!
Excellent service.

My two dogs have been going to Dog Walker for a few months now. They're anxious dogs, they don't adapt very quickly, but I've had a great experience at this daycare! They arrive happy and that always comforts me! The staff is attentive, the transport is great, and the price is fair! Niko and Tormenta are very grateful!

I took my dog ​​to this place based on a recommendation. I was very satisfied with the service. The staff were super courteous and helpful, taking excellent care of their four-legged guests. I will definitely return.
Thanks!
The staff were attentive and loving with the animals. They took great care of my kitten for three days.
Wonderful atmosphere
Excellent service, top-notch staff.
Excellent place to leave your dog! I recommend it!

Best daycare ever! Toffinho is always so excited and happy, he throws a party with the staff every time he arrives! And he must play a lot because he gets home and sleeps through the night, haha! All the services they offer are excellent (daycare, hotel, taxi, bathing...), always very attentive, careful and helpful. Congratulations to everyone!
Very good

I've been using their daycare, grooming, and dog taxi services since January, and I've also used their hotel. My dogs always go and come back very happy! The staff is responsible and always available! I recommend them 100%!
